body: If `ResourceCache::get_cached_resource_count()` is large (more external resources are opened), the results may be slightly better. Because when setting the path to empty, the unnecessary lookup call is now avoided entirely.

@Rindbee Could you run a benchmark with a larger cache? 
2% improvement is commendable, but nothing we normally merge unless it's in a bottleneck. Please see our [optimization guidelines](https://contributing.godotengine.org/en/latest/engine/guidelines/optimization.html) for details.

**Testing project:** [benchmark-resource-set-path.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23140543/benchmark-resource-set-path.zip)

## Benchmark

### Specifications

Linux Mint 22.2 (Zara) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - integrated AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV PHOENIX) - AMD Ryzen 7 8745H w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 threads) - 25.22 GiB memory

The following results were measured using an editor built with `scons`.

Use a Resource array and set the resource paths of its elements to simulate the cached Resource.
Path format: `res://{idx}.res`.

Given that the number of cached items is limited in practice, the number of loop calls is increased to get a more accurate measurement.

### Case 0: Change the path to be empty

Sets the resource paths of all elements in the array to empty, and then resets the resource paths of all its elements again.

| times=5 | cache count | loop count | min cost | max cost | average cost |
| :----: | :-----: | :-----: | :----: | :----: | :----: |
| Before | 100 | 1000 | 47.9ms | 49.7ms | 48.8ms (100%) |
| After | 100 | 1000 | 45.6ms | 46.4ms | 46.0ms (94.3%) | 
| Before | 200 | 1000 | 89.7ms | 94.3ms | 92.9ms (100%) |
| After | 200 | 1000 | 88.6ms | 90.1ms | 89.4ms (96.2%) | 
| Before | 500 | 1000 | 223.7ms | 234.1ms | 230.0ms (100%) |
| After | 500 | 1000 | 213.5ms | 223.5ms | 220.5ms (95.9%) | 
| Before | 1000 | 1000 | 463.5ms | 471.3ms | 466.5ms (100%) |
| After | 1000 | 1000 | 454.0ms | 459.4ms | 456.2ms (97.8%) | 

### Case 1: Modify the path (not empty)

Change the resource paths of all elements.
Path format: `old_path` + `"test"` 

| times=5 | cache count | loop count | min cost | max cost | average cost |
| :----: | :-----: | :-----: | :----: | :----: | :----: |
| Before | 100 | 1000 | 420.7ms | 424.3ms | 423.1ms (100%) |
| After | 100 | 1000 | 420.8ms | 423.8ms | 422.0ms (99.7%) | 
| Before | 200 | 1000 | 847.5ms | 850.0ms | 848.9ms (100%) |
| After | 200 | 1000 | 846.5ms | 850.2ms | 848.1ms (99.9%) | 
| Before | 500 | 1000 | 2149.6ms | 2165.1ms | 2155.2ms (100%) |
| After | 500 | 1000 | 2148.9ms | 2159.3ms | 2155.6ms (100%) | 
| Before | 1000 | 1000 | 4514.6ms | 4542.0ms | 4524.9ms (100%) |
| After | 1000 | 1000 | 4502.0ms | 4522.6ms | 4514.7ms (99.8%) |

Edit: The path may be too long, which causes it to take a long time.
